name: @datamoc/mw_games
description: A local-file game framework for 2D top-down games with optional Babylon.js 3D rendering.

scripts.build: npm run build:pkg && npm run build:global
scripts.example:build: vite build --config examples/colour-transform/vite.config.ts && node tools/emit-page.mjs examples/colour-transform
scripts.example:ui:build: vite build --config examples/interface/vite.config.ts && node tools/emit-page.mjs examples/interface
scripts.example:dialogue:build: vite build --config examples/dialogue/vite.config.ts && node tools/emit-page.mjs examples/dialogue
scripts.example:dungeon:build: vite build --config examples/dungeon/vite.config.ts && node tools/emit-page.mjs examples/dungeon
scripts.example:village:build: vite build --config examples/village/vite.config.ts && node tools/emit-page.mjs examples/village
scripts.example:battle:build: vite build --config examples/battle/vite.config.ts && node tools/emit-page.mjs examples/battle
scripts.example:minigame:build: vite build --config examples/minigame/vite.config.ts && node tools/emit-page.mjs examples/minigame
scripts.example:chess:build: vite build --config examples/chess/vite.config.ts && node tools/emit-page.mjs examples/chess
scripts.example:tower-defense:build: vite build --config examples/tower-defense/vite.config.ts && node tools/emit-page.mjs examples/tower-defense
scripts.example:3d:build: vite build --config examples/three-d/vite.config.ts && node tools/emit-page.mjs examples/three-d
scripts.benchmark:3d: npm run example:3d:build && node tools/benchmark-browser.mjs examples/three-d/dist/index.html
scripts.cap:add:android: npm run mobile:build && npm run cap:cli -- add android
scripts.cap:add:ios: npm run mobile:build && npm run cap:cli -- add ios
scripts.cap:sync: npm run mobile:build && npm run cap:cli -- sync
